appliesWhen.semanticAnchor: declaring QueryProcedure, QueryStatement, SqlQueryStatement, PgQueryStatement, or PgFunctionQuery in a static Queries catalog for SQL Server stored procedures and PostgreSQL procedures or functions

fields.body: Declare all `Query` definitions in a static `Queries` catalog class. Use `QueryProcedure` (`CommandType.StoredProcedure`) for SQL Server stored procedures (`EXEC`) and PostgreSQL `CREATE PROCEDURE` routines (`CALL` in Npgsql 7+). Use `QueryStatement` (`CommandType.Text`) or `PgFunctionQuery` for PostgreSQL `CREATE FUNCTION` and set-returning functions (`SELECT * FROM fn(...)`), because `CommandType.StoredProcedure` in Npgsql 7+ emits `CALL` and cannot invoke PostgreSQL functions. When both SQL Server and PostgreSQL statement files are used in the same process, use `SqlQueryStatement` (`.sql`) and `PgQueryStatement` (`.psql`) rather than mutating the shared static `QueryStatement.Extension` property.
fields.title: QueryProcedure vs. QueryStatement and PgFunctionQuery selection
